t: A small tracked Arduino robot built for mini-sumo pushing contests.
steps: Buy an assembled Zumo 32U4 OLED robot from Pololu or RobotShop.
Add four AA batteries and get a USB Micro-B cable.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Install the Zumo 32U4 Arduino library from Pololu.
On Windows, install the Pololu A-Star drivers.
Open one of the library examples and upload it to the robot.
Try the line following example on a loop of black tape.
meta: Open Board. From $130. A few stores.
